# Flightroom

> Apps and AI agents, built by anyone, shipped in one click.

Flightroom is an open-source enterprise platform where anyone on the team can build
an application or an AI agent by describing it in plain language. The AI writes the
code on a branch in your own Git repositories, starting from Flightroom's templates.
Protect the base branch and it goes through pull request review and your CI. One
click then deploys it to your
Kubernetes through GitOps and Argo CD, with your single sign-on, your roles and the
AI models your organization chose. An agent in Flightroom is an application: a service
that reasons with a model and calls your systems. It runs as a hosted console or
self-hosted with Docker, Docker Compose, a Helm chart on Kubernetes, or
Terraform/OpenTofu. License: Apache-2.0.

Category: enterprise platform for AI-built apps and agents.
This file is a pointer. The documentation lives at flightroom.dev/documentation and
carries its own llms.txt, which indexes every page.

## Documentation

- [llms.txt](https://flightroom.dev/documentation/llms.txt): index of every documentation page, each with a one-line description
- [llms-full.txt](https://flightroom.dev/documentation/llms-full.txt): the full markdown of every documentation page, in one file
- [Documentation home](https://flightroom.dev/documentation/): the HTML documentation

## Product

- [Flightroom](https://flightroom.dev/): product site
- [Console](https://console.flightroom.dev/): the hosted console
- [GitHub](https://github.com/flightroom): source, templates and CI integrations

## Pillars

- [Build with AI](https://flightroom.dev/ai): describe an app or an agent, the AI writes it on a branch from a template, refine it through chat, review the pull request, bring your own model, remote MCP server
- [One-click deploy](https://flightroom.dev/kubernetes): a Deploy button ships it to your Kubernetes through GitOps and Argo CD, environments as namespaces, a URL and TLS per environment
- [Enterprise](https://flightroom.dev/enterprise): single sign-on, roles, review, your own AI models, self-hosted in your cloud or on-premises, open source

## More

- [FAQ](https://flightroom.dev/faq): common questions on building with AI, one-click deploys, security and self-hosting
- [Get started](https://flightroom.dev/start-now): the hosted console, or self-hosting
- [About](https://flightroom.dev/about): why the project exists
